What you will learn

  • Design and build a REST API with Django REST Framework
  • Add authentication, permissions and validation
  • Containerize the app with Docker
  • Model data and write efficient queries in PostgreSQL
  • Write automated tests for your endpoints
  • Deploy it and set up a basic CI pipeline

Who this course is for

Good fit if you

  • Know Python basics and want to move into backend work
  • Are a frontend developer adding server-side skills
  • Want a portfolio project for job applications

Before you start

  • Variables, functions and loops in Python
  • Basic command line and Git
  • A laptop with Python 3.11 or newer

Course program

5 modules, 42 lessons, about 56 hours with practice.

Module 1. Python and Django basics

8 lessons (10 hours)

  • Project structure, settings and routing
  • Models, migrations and the admin
  • Views, templates and forms
Module 2. Databases and queries

8 lessons (11 hours)

Module 3. Building the REST API

9 lessons (12 hours)

Module 4. Testing and quality

8 lessons (10 hours)

Module 5. Deployment and final project

9 lessons (13 hours)
